thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3971234567 - GPU queue length alarm (prometheus) crossed threshold and autoscaler failed to add nodes. Pager fired to on-call.

pagerduty_bot: Pager sent to sara_oncall and ben_sre. Escalation level 1.

sara_oncall: ack — I'm on it. Pulling logs and metrics. DMing pager details.

ben_sre: oncall here, looking at cluster-autoscaler logs and ASG events. Queue looks real.

miguel_infra: I'll check AWS side (ASG / launch template / instance profiles). @sara_oncall any initial customer impact notes?

sara_oncall: early telemetry: hosted inference latency spiked, some heavy generation jobs returning 503 or queuing for >30s. Not full outage but high severity for a subset of customers using batch endpoints.

opsbot: Tagging incident: severity=P1, impacted=hosted-inference, component=gpu-provisioning.

ben_sre: quick snapshot: prometheus -> sum(inference_queue_length) = 10832. cluster-autoscaler logs: 
```
I0423 12:15:01 autoscaler.go:450] Failed to scale up: failed to create instance: validation error: launch template version mismatch
I0423 12:15:02 autoscaler.go:452] Waiting for capacity: hitting cloud provider scale limit
```

miguel_infra: AWS ASG activity: attempted scale requests returned MaxInstanceLimitExceeded. Current ASG: desired=10 max=10. Account GPU instance quota is at limit. Also saw mixed launch-template versions.

ben_sre: additionally, some new instances spun but kubelet failed to register due to x509 errors — AMI mismatch / CA bundle old. Those nodes got tainted and didn't join the GPU pool. So two failure modes combined: quota + failed join.

sara_oncall: TL;DR: queue blew up because autoscaler couldn't add usable GPU capacity (quota + LT/AMI mismatch causing node join failure). Need parallel mitigation: cloud quota + template fix + routing fallback.

miguel_infra: Confirmed: launch-template v5 has newest AMI; ASG was still using v3 (fallback). Also some instances failed to attach instance profile: error `InstanceProfileNotFound`.

anna_prod_eng: (added) re routing: we can throttle heavy-model requests server-side and route small/light jobs to CPU pool to reduce immediate GPU churn.

ben_sre: immediate actions I'm taking: cordon/untaint partially joined nodes, drain bad nodes, and spin up temporary CPU-only workers for low-cost requests.
```
kubectl taint nodes <node> node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoSchedule-
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

miguel_infra: I opened an AWS support case for quota bump (CASE-2026-0423). Requesting temporary instance quota increase. Also preparing a launch-template v6 with corrected AMI and instance profile.

ben_sre: attempted manual autoscaling update to point ASG to LT v5: 
```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-asg-prod --launch-template "LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc,Version=5"
```
Applying rolling replacement after update. Monitoring.

opsbot: Assigned `miguel_infra`, `ben_sre`, `anna_prod_eng` to incident and set status = investigating.

ben_sre: new instances started but kubelet errors persist on a subset: 
```
kubelet[1234]: E0423 12:27:10 kubelet.go:125] failed to register node: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
This points at AMI/CA mismatch on some LT versions.

miguel_infra: options: update ASG to v6 (new AMI + correct instance profile) and scale, or override user-data to fetch latest kube certs on boot (hacksy). I'm pushing v6 + instance profile fix.

anna_prod_eng: applying routing change now: lightweight requests TTL=15m to CPU pool, heavy models will be rate-limited to avoid exacerbating queue. Customers will see 429s for some batch jobs.

sara_oncall: customer comms draft in #support-ops: "We are experiencing degraded inference performance caused by GPU provisioning delays. Mitigations applied: temporary routing to CPU pool and increased capacity where possible. We will update with RCA."

miguel_infra: AWS approved a temporary +50 GPU quota for 2 hours. Increased ASG max to 25 and set LT version to v6 which includes the correct IAM instance profile.

ben_sre: after LT v6 + ASG max bump, new nodes are joining successfully ✅
```
kubectl get nodes | grep gpu
gpu-node-74   Ready   6h
gpu-node-75   Ready   2m
```
Queue length now trending down: 10832 -> 3121 (15m after scale).

sara_oncall: great. Keeping incident active while we watch for regressions. Post-incident items: RCA for launch-template drift, ASG validation, quota ownership map, and a runbook update for IAM instance profile checks.

opsbot: Incident remain P1 during mitigations. Scheduled handoff to night on-call @maria_oncall in 1h.

maria_oncall: taking handoff. Please ensure all runbook edits and the ASG/LT change lists are in the incident doc. I will monitor for 2h.

ben_sre: notes added to incident doc: add autoscaler tolerations for taint handling, add preflight check that ASG launch template version matches latest after deploy, add IAM profile attach validation on bake pipeline.

anna_prod_eng: sent customer update: "Mitigations applied; capacity scaled; some jobs may be rate-limited. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline." :thumbsup: 

sara_oncall: closing active mitigation in 30m if metrics hold. Final metrics: peak queue 10832; current 890; 503 error rate reduced from 4.8% -> 0.4%. No data loss reported.

opsbot: Recorded timeline and tags. Next steps: RCA meeting, update runbooks, quota ownership audit. :white_check_mark:
